[SWS_PHM_00223]
⌈
If
the
Global Supervision Status
was
GLOBAL_STATUS_OK, the Local Supervision Status of at least one Su-
pervised Entity Instance is LOCAL_STATUS_FAILED and no Supervised
Entity Instance is in Local Supervision Status LOCAL_STATUS_EXPIRED,
then the Platform Health Management shall change the Global Supervision
Status to GLOBAL_STATUS_FAILED.
⌋

[SWS_PHM_00223] Switch Global Supervision Status from kOK to kFAILED
⌈
If the Global Supervision Status is kOK, the Elementary Super-
vision Status of at least one Alive, Deadline or Logical Supervision is kFAILED
and no supervision is in Elementary Supervision Status kEXPIRED, then the
Platform Health Management shall change the Global Supervision Sta-
tus to kFAILED.
⌋
